Notify.GMOnly: Only a GM can do that.

Volley.NoAmmo: No ammunition loaded — the volley can't be fired as written.
Volley.Insufficient: Insufficient ammunition: needs {need}, only {have} loaded. Remaining rounds spent; resolve with your GM.
Volley.Prompt: Expend {n} from the loaded ammunition ({left} remaining)?
Volley.Selected: Selected {n} token(s) — use the card's save button to roll their saves.
Volley.RegionGone: That area is no longer on the current scene.

Suppress.Title: Suppressing Fire
Suppress.Body: {target} is suppressed by {attacker} until the start of {attacker}'s next turn (–1 circumstance to attacks, –10 ft status to Speeds).

Glitch.Title: Glitching — flat check DC {dc}
Glitch.CritSuccess: Systems stabilize. Glitching value reduced by 1.
Glitch.Failure: Item penalty of –{value} to all checks and DCs this turn.
Glitch.CritFailure: Item penalty of –{value} to all checks and DCs this turn, and Stunned 1.

Drift.Title: {name} is untethered
Drift.Body: End of turn: the creature drifts 5 feet in the last direction it moved.
Drift.NoDirection: No recorded movement direction for that token.

Ammo.Empty: {ammo} is empty. Reload before your next shot.

photon.Title: Photon Attunement
photon.Body: {name} blazes with stellar heat — plasma coils along every manifestation.

graviton.Title: Graviton Attunement
graviton.Body: Light bends around {name} as the weight of a dying star settles in.

unattuned.Title: Unattuned
unattuned.Body: {name}'s manifestations gutter out as the stellar cycle resets.

Ship.SceneNamePlaceholder: e.g., Ambush at the Drift Beacon
Ship.VictoryText: Victory conditions / additional objectives (from the scene stat block)
Ship.ResetBody: Clear the ship, crew assignments, threats, and round counter?
Ship.Bonuses: Starship bonuses and available starship actions
Ship.RoleCheck: Roll this role's skill (vs DC if entered)
Ship.Hit: Shields absorb {s}, hull takes {h}. Shields {sh}, HP {hp}/{max}.
Ship.PickRoles: Each PC picks a role at the start of their turn and holds it until the next round.
Ship.NoSkill: Skill '{skill}' not found on that character.

Comms.GMOnly: Only the GM can broadcast priority alerts.

Info.EditHint: One headline per line. Leave empty to restore the defaults.

Ledger.Title: Credits Ledger
Ledger.ClearConfirm: Delete every ledger entry? Balances on character sheets are not affected.

Payout.Title: Mission Payout
Payout.Nothing: Nothing to pay: check the amount and recipients.

Faction.Title: Faction Standing
Faction.TiersHint: One tier per line as minimum = label. A faction's tier is the highest whose minimum it meets.

volleyAmmo.Name: Area Fire / Auto-Fire ammunition
volleyAmmo.Hint: Spend ammunition for area attacks (the system doesn't). Area Fire uses the weapon's expend; Auto-Fire spends 2 × creatures in the placed cone.

volleyAutoTarget.Name: Target creatures in placed areas
volleyAutoTarget.Hint: When you place an Area Fire / Auto-Fire area, target every creature inside it.

suppressionAuto.Name: Apply Suppressing Fire
suppressionAuto.Hint: Soldiers with Suppressing Fire: enemies who fail the save against their area attack become suppressed until the start of the soldier's next turn.

glitchingAuto.Name: Glitching start-of-turn check
glitchingAuto.Hint: Roll the DC 5 + value flat check when a glitching combatant's turn starts, and apply the outcome.

untetheredDrift.Name: Untethered drift reminder
untetheredDrift.Hint: At end of turn, give the GM a one-click 5-foot drift in the token's last movement direction.

ammoWarnPct.Name: Low-ammo warning threshold (%)
ammoWarnPct.Hint: Warn owners when a magazine or battery falls to this percentage. Always warns when empty. 0 = empty only.

ammoWarnSound.Name: Low-ammo sound
ammoWarnSound.Hint: Optional sound for low/empty ammunition warnings (this client).

attunementLight.Name: Solarian attunement lighting
attunementLight.Hint: Change a solarian's token light when they become photon- or graviton-attuned; restore it when unattuned.

attunementChat.Name: Solarian attunement chat flourish
attunementChat.Hint: Post a short narrative card when a solarian's attunement changes.

infosphereEnabled.Name: Infosphere feed
infosphereEnabled.Hint: Broadcast a random infosphere headline as in-world time passes.

ledgerEnabled.Name: Credits ledger
ledgerEnabled.Hint: Log every change to party characters' credits and UPBs.
